summary: Verastem filed a Form 8-K reporting preliminary unaudited Q3 2026 results, with estimated net product revenue of $23.9–$24.1 million versus $11.2 million a year earlier, and cash, cash equivalents and investments of roughly $172.8 million versus $137.7 million at September 30, 2025. The filing also includes an Item 5.02 officer/director departure or appointment disclosure, plus Regulation FD and other-event items. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated, so this is a routine earnings-and-governance current report rather than a special situation.
